name: Holt & Vargas - Document Intake & Completeness Review

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ full_name: $('Set Fields').first().json.full_name, email: $('Set Fields').first().json.email, phone: $('Set Fields').first().json.phone, country_of_origin: $('Set Fields').first().json.country_of_origin, preferred_language: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.preferred_language }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ client_id: $('Extract Client ID').first().json.client_id, case_type: $('Set Fields').first().json.case_type, paralegal_id: $('Assign Paralegal').first().json.paralegal_id }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  source_event_id: $('Guard').first().json.source_event_id,
  case_id: $('Extract Case ID').first().json.case_id,
  client_id: $('Extract Client ID').first().json.client_id,
  document_description: $('Set Fields').first().json.document_description,
  completeness_score: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.completeness_score ?? null,
  completeness_label: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.completeness_label ?? 'Unknown',
  documents_ready: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.catalogue_present ?? [],
  documents_unready: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.catalogue_missing ?? [],
  documents_received: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.catalogue_present ?? [],
  documents_missing: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.catalogue_missing ?? [],
  ai_summary: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.ai_summary ?? '',
  ai_notes: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.ai_notes ?? '',
  confidence_level: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.confidence_level ?? null,
  notes: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.ai_summary ?? ''
}) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ (function(p){ return JSON.stringify(p.review_ran ? { success: true, message: 'Intake received and processed', client: $('Set Fields').first().json.full_name, case_type: $('Set Fields').first().json.case_type } : { success: true, status: 'accepted_unreviewed', message: p.nothing_to_review ? 'Intake received and recorded. No documents were described, so nothing was reviewed and the client has been asked what they hold.' : 'Intake received and recorded. The automated document review did not run and a paralegal will review this by hand.', client: $('Set Fields').first().json.full_name, case_type: $('Set Fields').first().json.case_type }); })($('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'deepseek-v4-flash', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.deepseek_body }], max_tokens: 5000 }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success:false, status:'rejected', reasons: $('Guard').first().json.guard_reasons, source_event_id: $('Guard').first().json.source_event_id || null }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ success:true, status:'duplicate', message:'This submission was already processed; nothing was written and no email was sent.', source_event_id: $('Guard').first().json.source_event_id }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), webhook: 'hvl-intake', source_event_id: $('Guard').first().json.source_event_id || null, status: 'started', stage: 'guard', started_at: $now.toISO() }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), status: 'rejected', stage: 'guard', finished_at: $now.toISO(), error_message: ($('Guard').first().json.guard_reasons || []).join('; ') }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), status: 'ok', stage: 'duplicate', finished_at: $now.toISO() }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), stage: 'classified', case_type: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.case_type || null, completeness_score: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.completeness_score, completeness_label: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.completeness_label, confidence_level: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.confidence_level, priority_flag: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.priority_flag, contract_violated: $('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.contract_violated, model: 'deepseek-v4-flash', prompt_tokens: ($('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.deepseek_raw_response||{}).usage?.prompt_tokens ?? null, completion_tokens: ($('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.deepseek_raw_response||{}).usage?.completion_tokens ?? null, total_tokens: ($('Parse Deepseek Response').first().json.deepseek_raw_response||{}).usage?.total_tokens ?? null }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), status: 'ok', stage: 'sent', finished_at: $now.toISO(), client_id: $('Extract Client ID').first().json.client_id || null, case_id: $('Extract Case ID').first().json.case_id || null, review_id: ($('Insert Document Review').first().json || {}).id || null }) }}
